canonical_name: No Contact with Special Interest Groups
description: Organization has not established contacts with security forums and professional associations for threat intelligence.
applicability: Applies when an organization is not engaged with security communities, industry groups, information sharing forums, or professional associations that could provide threat intelligence and security best practices.

metadata.detection_notes: Review memberships in security organizations, assess participation in information sharing forums, verify subscriptions to threat intelligence feeds, check attendance at security conferences, evaluate engagement with industry-specific security groups.
